scoring_justification: T1 infeasible because the BDE values are the output of a heavy DFT workflow that cannot be rerun in the verifier sandbox; comparing agent's reported values to paper-reported reference with tolerance is the appropriate verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference bond dissociation energies (BDEs) at B3LYP/6-311+G(d,p) level from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text (refs 17,18,19); computed B3LYP/6-311+G(d,p) values reported: anisole O-CH3 BDE 62.1 kcal/mol, phenol O-H BDE 89.7 kcal/mol, alkyl C-H BDE 93.7 kcal/mol.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's results section.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact paper-reported numbers for the same quantities/same units; the checker compares the agent's computed values to them.

outputs.description: Computed bond dissociation energies (BDEs) for anisole O-CH3, phenol O-H, and toluene methyl C-H bonds at the B3LYP/6-311+G(d,p) level including zero-point energy corrections.

output_contract.notes: The molecular free-volume calculations using Cerius2 are omitted because they rely on proprietary software and are not part of the main mechanistic claim scoped for reproduction.

steps.description: Compare each reported BDE to the paper reference values within ±2.0 kcal/mol; score = proportion of values within tolerance.
